# Cinematic Pointer

Compact LLM context index for this repository.

Cinematic Pointer replays a scripted web journey in a real browser, records it with a cursor overlay and
edits it into a trailer. MADFAM uses it to film the public pages of its products and tiers. It is a
command-line tool (TypeScript, Playwright, FFmpeg); nothing here is deployed.

## Read first

- `AGENTS.md` — canonical agent operating instructions.
- `README.md` — human/product overview when present.
- `ECOSYSTEM.md` — MADFAM ecosystem and Enclii deployment context when present.
- `llms-full.txt` — full context map and durable operating contract.
- `docs/REPO_BOUNDARY.md` — what may and may not live in this public repository.

## Where things are

- `src/cli.ts`, `src/commands/` — commands: `run`, `cut`, `reframe`, `doctor`, `catalog`, `produce`, `capture page`, `export`, `tour`.
- `src/cinema/` — page capture, the auto-director (screenplay, primary call to action) and the cinematic stage.
- `src/pointer/` — the pointer as protagonist: outfits, personas, motion (`pointerAt`) and its part in a screenplay.
- `src/recorders/` — `stepped` and stage (frame-by-frame) recorders.
- `src/executor/`, `src/drivers/`, `src/overlay/` — journey replay and the cursor overlay.
- `src/postprod/` — FFmpeg edit, captions, reframe, export.
- `src/catalog/` — trailer catalog: products to journeys, batch results and exit rules.
- `catalog/products.json` — GENERATED product list (never hand-edit); `catalog/pricing-pages.json` is hand-kept.
- `journeys/generated/` — GENERATED journeys; `npm run catalog:check` guards them.

## Production operations

Routine production operations are Enclii-first. Use Enclii web, API, or CLI
before raw infrastructure tools. Direct `kubectl`, `helm`, SSH, provider CLIs,
`docker exec`, or direct container access is bootstrap/break-glass only.
